items.question: Is PipelineOS a full CRM system?
items.answer: Yes. It manages leads, deals, activities, reminders and reporting for sales teams.

items.question: What makes it different from spreadsheets?
items.answer: PipelineOS keeps ownership, history and next steps connected so work does not get lost.

items.question: How does PipelineOS help improve sales alignment?
items.answer: Every team member works from the same stages, notes and activity records.

items.question: Can PipelineOS adapt to different sales processes?
items.answer: Yes. Stages, fields and automations can be adjusted around your workflow.

items.question: Can I try it before choosing a plan?
items.answer: Yes. Teams can start small and upgrade when they need more features.
